mapper.select: select d.id, d.class_id, d.campus_id, d.teacher_id, d.duty_date, d.duty_type, d.start_time, d.end_time, d.remark, d.created_at, d.updated_at, c.class_period as class_period, camp.campus_location as campus_name, coalesce(nullif(u.real_name, ''), nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username) as teacher_name from sys_class_duty d left join sys_class c on c.id = d.class_id left join sys_campus camp on camp.id = d.campus_id left join sys_user u on u.id = d.teacher_id where d.duty_date = #{dutyDate} order by d.duty_type asc, d.class_id asc, d.campus_id asc, d.id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_class_duty (class_id, campus_id, teacher_id, duty_date, duty_type, start_time, end_time, remark, created_at, updated_at) values
(#{item.classId}, #{item.campusId}, #{item.teacherId}, #{item.dutyDate}, #{item.dutyType}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.endTime}, #{item.remark}, now(), now())
